name: Chulane, Teller of Tales
description: {"ops":[{"insert":"Chulane, Teller of Tales. Ramp. Play Chulane. Protect him. Play low mana-cost creatures to trigger Chulane's ability to draw cards and play more lands. People will target you instantly. You must weather the storm and gain enough value through Chulane's ability when the opportunity presents itself. Shrieking Drake is the best card in this deck.  You can get infinite mana with Peregrine Drake and Deadeye Navigator, play Shrieking Drake infinite times, and then play a Laboratory Maniac for the win. Or you can hit a bunch of good landfall or creaturefall ability's to make an army of Beasts of Zombies and drop a Moonshaker Cavalry to swing for the win.\n"}]}
